pages.title: Legendary Tools
pages.text: Some items in $(mod_name) have been modified.$(br2)These items possess unique abilities.

pages.title: Ender Crystal Destroyer
pages.text: The $(item)Adamantium Pickaxe$() is $(important)the ONLY tool$() in the entire game capable of destroying $(thing)Ender Crystals$().$(br2)Without it, you cannot defeat the Ender Dragon.$(br2)Crafted on the Netherite Crafting Table.

pages.title: Swift Composure
pages.text: $(thing)Effect:$() Right-click to gain a speed boost.$().$(br2)While its primary purpose is farming, the speed bonus makes it an excellent exploration tool.$(br2)$(note)Traverse any terrain with swift composure.$()
